finding: B0/peer FAILS the state-equivalence gate: the Silero VAD v5 RNN hidden state carries long context. Parity fails in 74/186 episodes (112 pass trivially, their scored regions contain no B0 boundary). A warm-up convergence diagnostic on a failing episode shows exact parity only from ~60 s warm-up (5/15/30 s warm-up differ). Per PRD Section 5.4 and invariant 26, reset-plus-warm-up scored evaluation is forbidden for B0/peer; scored episodes must use deterministic source-prefix state (full-session replay with the episode scored region sliced from the source-prefix trace). The failed parity cases remain diagnostic evidence and are not hidden by increasing warm-up.
